title: Shaadi No. 1
desc: In their misguided pursuit of happiness outside of marriage, three husbands end up in the crosshairs of a man who is like an elder brother to their wives.

title: Radhe
desc: Radhe, a daredevil encounter specialist of the Mumbai Police force, vows to knock down the crime syndicate led by an evil drug lord.

title: Gadar: Ek Prem Katha
desc: During Partition, Tara and Sakina marry and enjoy a happy life together. However, Sakina's father forces her to remain in Pakistan, tearing the couple apart.

title: Suriya S3
desc: Durai Singham, an honest and uncompromising DCP, takes on a businessman and his goons who are involved in illegal dumping of toxic waste and causing serious health concerns.

title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
desc: A man is challenged to work in a field and produce a huge harvest by the end of the season in order to marry the love of his life.

title: Qatil Saya
desc: A police officer investigates the mystery behind unnatural deaths after taking charge of his new post at a hill station.

title: Milenge Milenge
desc: Priya believes she has met her destined lover when she meets and falls in love with Amit, but they soon part ways due to differences. Fate, however, perpetually conspires to bring them back together.

title: Kites
desc: Jay, a dance instructor, falls in love with Tony's fiancée. They make their daring escape and get married, but Tony is determined to track them down.

title: Go Goa Gone
desc: Things take a dangerous turn when the aftermath of a rave party causes three friends to get stranded on an isolated island infested with zombies.

title: Commando 3
desc: Commando Karan Singh Dogra and Inspector Bhavna Reddy race against time to thwart a terrorist attack on India. Later, they realise that foiling mastermind Buraq's plan is harder than it seems.

title: Om Bheem Bush
desc: Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Karan and Arjun, two brothers driven by revenge, are murdered by their uncle while seeking justice for their father's death. However, they resurrect years later to settle their unfinished score.

title: Dream Girl
desc: A man lands a call center job by mimicking a woman's voice, gaining fame and a loyal fan base. However, his double life spirals out of control when rabid clients overstep boundaries.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest police officer, is tasked with curbing Tezpur's rampant crime rates. Here he must work with his fellow corrupt officers and deal with the town's insidious political figures.
